notes: Tuition: no quote ties this programme to tuition area A or B, and no quote names Morocco in the country groups, so the FALLBACK range (lowest to highest) of the second-installment figures applying to a non-EU student with household income/assets abroad (country group C) is given: €3,204.00 (area A) to €4,101.12 (area B) per year, from the 2026/2027 fees page. First instalment of €146 and the regional tax (€130–€190) are separate fees, not tuition. The country-group list (allegato 2) was not found among the pages, so the group C membership of Morocco could not be quoted. Intakes: the admission application window 12/03/2026–06/07/2026 is the general single-session call for this programme; the 31/07/2026 Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline is the visa pre-enrolment deadline, not the admission deadline. More rounds of rankings and enrolments exist (see the Call).
